_comment: Recipe knowledge ladder (systems/recipe_knowledge.gd, .scratch/recipe-acquisition/spec.md) -- provisional numbers, tagged for balance. rungs = the ladder in order (base, then data/lab.json's hint rungs); rungCeilings = the highest rank a recipe can reach with every rung up to and including that one owned. sellers: a recipe belongs to the first seller whose ores list holds every one of its ingredient ores, else to defaultSeller. sourceAliases maps a grant source id onto a seller id (the Guild faction draws on Wren's recipes). collision = the fallback when a sourced grant would teach nothing new and the source has no other recipe left to teach: crafting xp, relation bump with the source, and the acknowledgement line keyed by source id, else its alias, else default. masterSources.<recipeKey> = { source: npc/faction id or null, pointer: text or null }; a null pointer reads as unknownPointer. PROSE-REVIEW: collision.lines, unknownPointer.

lines.default: Nothing you didn't already know. You practise it anyway, and it shows.
lines.james: "You know this one." James watches you work it through regardless. "Then do it properly."
lines.wren: Wren checks her ledger. "Already on your file. I'll note the diligence instead."
